leadText:
Zander (Japanese: ゼンキチ Zenkichi) is a character of the day who appeared in Caterpie's Big Dilemma.

A student of Dr. Gordon's, Zander appears to spend most of his time at the doctor's lab. It was there that the young boy met and , who he believed were thieves trying to sneak into the lab. When he realized that they were actually heading to Saffron City, he immediately apologized.

Soon afterwards, broke into the doctor's lab and spilled some of Dr. Gordon's Mystery Candy Complete, which a that Zander had been caring for immediately ate. The Pokémon immediately began growing to enormous proportions before escaping the lab and wreaking havoc in a nearby city.

Suddenly, Team Rocket reappeared and kidnapped Dr. Gordon, fleeing on their giant , who had also been fed the Mystery Candy Complete. Caterpie eventually evolved into a Metapod, and again into . With the help of Zander and Ash, it saved the doctor from Team Rocket. Afterwards, Butterfree shrunk back down to its normal size. Zander was proud of Butterfree for saving the doctor and vowed to train it and bade farewell to Ash and the others, hoping that he and Ash would meet again someday.
